sources.title: TBS: Dengue toll at 439 on 3 November

quotes.text: Six more people died of dengue, taking this year's death toll to 439, and 2010 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country in the 24 hours until 8am today (3 November).
According to the report, a total of 140,909 dengue patients have, so far, been hospitalized across the country this year.

The Public Security Division's Police-1 Branch issued two separate notifications today, signed by Deputy Secretary Tauhif Ahmed. The notifications, issued in the public interest, stated that the transfer and posting orders would take immediate effect.
